Title: Action required: Prepare users who can’t use passkeys for SMS and voice retirement
Summary: Prepare users relying solely on Microsoft-provided SMS/voice MFA for sign-ins that don’t support passkeys by February 1, 2027 (non-admins) and July 1, 2027 (admins/external). Register compatible alternatives or configure customer-managed telephony to avoid sign-in blocks during phased retirement.
